request_payload.title: Neurofibromin regulation of ERK signaling modulates GABA release and learning.

mentions.sentence: Our results demonstrate that neurofibromin modulates ERK/synapsin I-dependent GABA release, which in turn modulates hippocampal LTP and learning.
